三种学习信号：答案、结构、分数: Three learning signals: answers, structure, a score
信号：每个样例都带标准答案: Signal: every example comes with the answer
问法：给新样例，答案是什么？: Question: given a new example, what is the answer?
代价：标注要人、要钱、要时间: Cost: labels take people, money, time
信号：没有答案，只有数据本身: Signal: no answers, only the data itself
问法：数据自己长什么样？: Question: what shape does the data itself have?
典型：聚类、降维、找异常: Typical: clustering, dimensionality reduction, anomaly finding
代价：结果好不好，很难打分: Cost: hard to score whether the result is any good
信号：没有答案，只有分数: Signal: no answers, only a score
（这步棋走完，整局输赢几分）: (how the whole game went after this move)
代价：试错要真环境、真代价: Cost: trial and error needs a real environment and real stakes
短板：分数来得晚、来得稀，: Weakness: the score is late and sparse, so
这一步是好是坏: was this step good or bad
答案（监督）、只有数据（无监督）、只有分数（强化）。: answers (supervised), data alone (unsupervised), a score alone (reinforcement).
